slides.03.aria: What an immersive LED space is
slides.03.title: What an immersive LED space is
slides.03.line: Not a screen on a wall. A space people step into.
slides.03.elementsAria: Components of an immersive LED space
slides.04.aria: One center. Several reasons to come and stay
slides.04.title:
One center.
Several reasons
to come and stay.
slides.04.line: Onsen, yoga, rain space, salt room, Thai massage, splash park, kids zone, game scenarios, smart training, green zone, festivals, Thai ceremony, social zone, rooftop bar, and coworking place are not separate functions. They are scenarios within one route: recover, slow down, activate, meet, and stay into the evening.
slides.04.punchline: Not a list of rooms. A route of states.
slides.04.card01.title: Onsen: Japanese mountains
slides.04.card01.copy: Steam, stone, warm light, and panoramic LED walls.
slides.04.card02.title: Yoga: sunrise mode
slides.04.card02.copy: Sunrise, forest, or ocean on the walls changes the state from the first minutes.
slides.04.card03.title: Rain space
slides.04.card03.copy: Controlled rain, light, and sound create a sensory reset.
slides.04.card04.title: Salt room
slides.04.card04.copy: Salt, warm light, and media panels create a quiet breathing scenario.
slides.04.card05.title: Splash park
slides.04.card05.copy: Water, light, and play elements give children a bright daytime scenario.
slides.04.card06.title: Kids zone
slides.04.card06.copy: A soft play environment keeps family traffic inside the center.
slides.04.card07.title: Virtual reality game zone
slides.04.card07.copy: Digital games and movement scenarios add energy and repeat visits.
slides.04.card08.title: Smart training
slides.04.card08.copy: LED screens, gym equipment, and game metrics turn sport into an engagement scenario.
slides.04.card09.title: Green zone
slides.04.card09.copy: The garden by the pool gives the eyes a pause between bright LED scenarios.
slides.04.card10.title: Dragon festival
slides.04.card10.copy: A large LED scenario turns a cultural festival into a reason for a mass visit.
slides.04.card11.title: Thai light ceremony
slides.04.card11.copy: Local culture, light, and sound give Madison Park an evening scenario for guests and partners.
slides.04.card12.title: Rooftop pool bar
slides.04.card12.copy: Sunset, pool, and bar mode turn the day into an evening destination.
slides.04.card13.title: Coworking place
slides.04.card13.copy: A work zone keeps guests on site during the day and links leisure with business meetings.
slides.04.card14.title: Social zone
slides.04.card14.copy: Guests stay after the scenarios, meet, and continue the evening in an LED setting.
slides.04.card15.title: Thai massage
slides.04.card15.copy: Deep recovery after active scenarios brings the body back to a calm rhythm.
slides.05.aria: The scenario changes. The zone purpose remains
slides.05.title:
The scenario changes.
The zone purpose remains.
slides.05.line: LED content, light, sound, and layout let each zone work in different modes without losing its core role.
slides.05.yoga.title: Yoga hall
slides.05.yoga.text: The environment changes, not the practice.
slides.05.event.title: Immersive event hall
slides.05.event.text: The layout, theme, and format change.
slides.05.event.dinoText: A family daytime scenario with a large LED world and high throughput.
slides.05.event.oceanText: A water scenario for families and tour groups.
slides.05.logic.title: Not a random change of images.
slides.05.logic.text: Each zone has its own range: yoga changes the environment, the event hall changes the format, and recovery changes the depth of state.
slides.05.logic.punchline: Scenarios keep the guest inside the route longer.
slides.06.title: Why now
slides.06.line: The format is already emerging globally, and Phuket has an opportunity window.

slides.08.media.caption: Madison Park Center — immersive recovery, activity, social, and events destination
slides.08.title: One project. Two capitalizations.
slides.08.line: Madison Park Center creates a standalone operating business and strengthens the value of the entire development project at the same time.
slides.08.badgesAria: Scale of the operating business and development uplift
slides.08.badge.revenue.label: revenue potential
slides.08.badge.development.label: plus hotel value uplift
slides.08.punchline: Value does not start after opening. It starts working at the concept stage.
slides.08.jitmax.title: Operating business
slides.08.jitmax.summary: Entry, recovery, food and beverage, events, retail
slides.08.madison.title: USP for Madison Park
slides.08.modal.jitmax.title: A strong business, not an infrastructure add-on
slides.08.modal.jitmax.text: The center works as a separate commercial system: entry flow, recovery, activities, food and beverage, events, private bookings, retail, and advertising surfaces.
slides.08.modal.jitmax.stack03: Food and beverage, events, private bookings
slides.08.modal.madison.title: The center raises the value of the whole project
slides.08.modal.madison.text: Madison Park gets more than infrastructure. It gets a destination anchor that helps sell residences, strengthens the hotel, and gives the market a reason to talk about the project before construction is complete.
slides.08.modal.madison.item04: Marketing — gets a visual USP before construction
slides.08.modal.madison.emphasis: The concept starts working for sales before the object opens.
slides.09.title: Next step: sketch stage
slides.09.lead: The concept is ready. Now it needs to be tested on the Madison Park site: site fit, scenarios, budget, operating model, and partnership structure.
slides.09.lead.rest: Now it needs to be tested on the Madison Park site: site fit, scenarios, budget, operating model, and partnership structure.
slides.09.callout.title: Control point 2: sketch stage
slides.09.callout.copy: Reference point: about 4 million THB. This is the validation budget before documentation, construction, and launch.
slides.09.scope.line: Scope: site, scenarios, budget, operating model, legal framework, investor package.
slides.09.scope.modal.title: What we create for 4 million THB
slides.09.scope.modal.note: Before documentation, construction, and launch, this stage validates the project legally, technically, operationally, commercially, and financially.
slides.09.scope.card01.title: Stage management and calendar
slides.09.scope.card01.copy: Stage management, 12-16 week calendar, reports, budget, minutes, decision register, risk register, and coordination between Jitmax, the developer, and investors.
slides.09.scope.card02.title: Legal and development framework
slides.09.scope.card02.copy: Company, licenses, BOI review, participation structure, LOI / MOU, land terms, construction readiness, infrastructure, facade, and signage.
slides.09.scope.card03.title: Site, master plan, and scenarios
slides.09.scope.card03.copy: Site review, engineering inputs, master plan, area program, guest and service flows, daytime and evening scenarios, and transitions between zones.
slides.09.scope.card04.title: Design and contractor review
slides.09.scope.card04.copy: Architecture sketch for 500k THB, interior sketch for 500k THB, LED, sound and media systems, engineering systems, wet zones, recovery equipment, finishes, kitchen, and bar.
slides.09.scope.card05.title: Operating and commercial model
slides.09.scope.card05.copy: Org structure, operating director, team and payroll, operating standards, key metrics, CRM, tickets and access, brand, product matrix, pricing, packages, and cross-zone sales.
slides.09.scope.card06.title: Finance and investor package
slides.09.scope.card06.copy: CAPEX / OPEX, revenue streams, MIN / BASE / MAX scenarios, break-even point, payback period, financing need, use of proceeds, presentation, teaser, investor memo, and data room.
